text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser was injured during 
training, so we rushed over to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
With this injury, I'll have to take a 
break from training for a while, won't 
I... Mmm-mmm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I can bear a little pain, so can't 
I please train...?
choice_data_list:
Let's pause for a moment so that you can 
keep running in the long run.
Shall we explore what options we have?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hau... You're right... It's dangerous to 
push myself too hard, after all...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"All I can do right now is heal my injury 
quickly... I'll be on my best behavior 
today..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser spoke with 
disappointment and returned to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's head out to the track 
right away and see if there's anything we 
can do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah... It's no good... The moment I put 
any strength into it, it throbs with sharp 
pain.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like all I can do right now is 
rest... Sigh..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking like she was in pain, 
Matikanetannhauser slowly made her way 
back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Phew! As long as I don't go at a full 
sprint, it seems I'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we can manage training like 
this until it's fully healed! Whew, what a 
relief!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mindful of her injury, Matikanetannhauser 
trained reasonably within her limits.
